description: Flip a feature status. Updates feature.json and regenerates ROADMAP.md. Enforces a transition policy (use force: true to bypass). When the evidence capability is on, COMPLETE needs a `sha` or `command` receipt (`evidence`, refused EVIDENCE_REQUIRED without one); PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, BLOCKED and PARKED need none. Appends an audit event (best-effort).

evidence.description: Receipt for the claim, re-checked by the server (contracts/evidence.schema.json): an object {kind, at (ISO time), by (session), ...kind fields} with kind sha {repo, sha, branch? (a land_branches name, e.g. "2.0")} | process {pid, launched_at, label, exit_file?, log?} (checked at launch + 120 s or later) | file {path, line?} | log {path, line} | screenshot {path, region?} | command {command, output_line, log} | pixel {path, point {x, y}, expected "#rrggbb"}; or an "ev:<id>" from `node lib/evidence-cli.js record`. Refused without one (EVIDENCE_REQUIRED) unless the workspace sets capabilities.evidence false. The accepted id comes back as evidence_id.

force.description: Bypass the transition policy AND the roundtrip fixed-point guard (commits even if ROADMAP.md would not be a generation fixed point). Recorded in audit.

reason.description: Free-form reason persisted in the audit event

name: set_feature_status
